description: For every first-order sentence \(\sigma\) in a language \(L\), there exist a language \(W\) of fresh function symbols and a universal sentence \(\tau\) in \(L\cup W\), chosen independently of any background theory, such that for every set \(T\) of \(L\)-sentences, \(T\cup\{\sigma\}\) has a nonempty model if and only if \(T\cup\{\tau\}\) does in the expanded language.
